info.name: CareAcademy Compliance Report Sign In Url API
Retrieve a sign in url for a given user for Single Sign On. Either userIntegrationId or email is required. User integration ID is preferred.

params.name: userIntegrationId
params.description: The external system's user ID. This is typically the ID of the user's record in the system making a call to the CareAcademy API.

params.name: email
params.description: The email address of the user being signed in.
